abilities.notes: Package 3 V9 returned-id fix (F-COM-05). Prior registrar used wpFluent insert() which returns boolean; the returned message_id was always cast from true to 1. insertGetId() returns the auto-increment primary key of the inserted row. No vendor model wraps fcom_chat_messages directly at this level; direct wpFluent insert is the appropriate path. This package corrects only the id-return shape.
abilities.rationale: Raw wpFluent insertGetId() is the appropriate write path: no vendor model wraps fcom_chat_messages at this level; insertGetId() returns the auto-increment primary key (the id list-messages sees), correcting the prior boolean->1 V9 returned-id defect.
